en.purpose: To provide clinical decision support and recommendations regarding the use of CT imaging in minor head trauma.
en.use:
Use to assess the  Canadian CT head rule criteria:

If ANY of the 5 High-Risk criteria are present -> Recommend CT Head (High risk).

If NO High-Risk criteria are present, but ANY of the 2 Medium-Risk criteria are present -> Recommend CT Head (Medium risk).

If ALL criteria are absent -> CT head not required.
en.misuse: Do not use if the patient did not experience a trauma, has a Glasgow Coma Scale score lower than 13, is younger than 16 years, is taking warfarin or has a bleeding disorder, or has an obvious open skull fracture.
